answer: The inlet holds work receipts rather than names, so the falcon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the beacon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
